pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa upaṭṭhāko mahāmatto āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa dūtena cīvaracetāpanaṃ pāhesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.3: iminā cīvaracetāpanena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā ayyaṃ upanandaṃ cīvarena acchādehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.4: athakho so dūto yenāyasmā upanando sakyaputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.5: idaṃ kho bhante āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.7: evaṃ vutte āyasmā upanando sakyaputto taṃ dūtaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.8: na kho mayaṃ āvuso cīvaracetāpanaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma cīvarañca kho mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma kālena kappiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.9: evaṃ vutte so dūto āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.11: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako ārāmaṃ agamāsi kenacideva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.12: athakho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto taṃ dūtaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.13: eso kho āvuso upāsako bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccakaroti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.14: athakho so dūto taṃ upāsakaṃ saññāpetvā yenāyasmā upanando sakyaputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.15: yaṃ kho bhante āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi saññatto so mayā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.16: upasaṅkamatu āyasmā kālena cīvarena taṃ acchādessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.19: āyasmā upanando sakyaputto taṃ upāsakaṃ na kiñci avacāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.20: dutiyampi kho so mahāmatto āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa santike dūtaṃ pāhesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.21: paribhuñjatu ayyo taṃ cīvaraṃ icchāma mayaṃ ayyena taṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuttanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.1.22: dutiyampi kho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto taṃ upāsakaṃ na kiñci avacāsi.

pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena nigamassa samayo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.2: nigamena ca katikā katā hoti yo pacchā āgacchati paññāsambaddhoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.3: athakho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto yena so upāsako tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.5: ajjuṇho bhante āgamehi ajja nigamassa samayo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.6: nigamena ca katikā katā hoti yo pacchā āgacchati paññāsambaddhoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.7: ajjeva me āvuso cīvaraṃ dehīti ovaṭṭikāya parāmasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.8: athakho so upāsako āyasmatā upanandena sakyaputtena nippīḷiyamāno āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā pacchā agamāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.10: kissa tvaṃ ayya pacchā āgato paññāsaṃ jinosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.11: athakho so upāsako tesaṃ manussānaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.15: kathaṃ hi nāma upanando sakyaputto upāsakena
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.17: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.18: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.19: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto upāsakena
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.21: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.28: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.2.29: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.1: bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa rājā vā rājabhoggo vā brāhmaṇo vā gahapatiko vā dūtena cīvaracetāpanaṃ pahiṇeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.2: iminā cīvaracetāpanena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.3: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.4: idaṃ kho bhante āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ paṭiggaṇhātu āyasmā cīvaracetāpananti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.5: tena bhikkhunā so dūto evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.6: na kho mayaṃ āvuso cīvaracetāpanaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma cīvarañca kho mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma kālena kappiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.7: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.9: cīvaratthikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.11: so ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.12: yaṃ kho bhante āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi saññatto so mayā upasaṅkamatu āyasmā kālena cīvarena taṃ acchādessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.13: cīvaratthikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṅkamitvā dvittikkhattuṃcode tabbo sāretabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.15: dvittikkhattuṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.16: no ce abhinipphādeyya catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.17: catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhībhūto uddissa tiṭṭhamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ no ce abhinipphādeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.18: tato ce uttariṃ vāyamamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.19: no ce abhinipphādeyya yatassa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ dūto vā pāhetabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.20: yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ pahiṇittha na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:1.3.21: yuñjantāyasmanto sakaṃ mā vo sakaṃ vinassāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.2: bhikkhussatthāya bhikkhuṃ ārammaṇaṃ karitvā bhikkhuṃ acchādetukāmo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.10: ṭhapetvā rājānaṃ rājabhoggaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ avaseso gahapatiko nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.12: hiraññaṃ vā suvaṇṇaṃ vā maṇi vā muttā vā masāragallaṃ vā phaliko vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.19: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya

pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.28: so ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya

pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.30: cīvaratthikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṅkamitvā dvittikkhattuṃ codetabbo sāretabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.32: na vattabbo dehi me cīvaraṃ āhara me cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭehi me cīvaraṃ cetāpehi me cīvaranti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.36: no ce abhinipphādeti tattha gantvā tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.37: na āsane nisīditabbaṃ na āmisaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.39: kiṃkāraṇā āgatosīti pucchamāno jānāhi āvusoti vattabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np10:2.1.40: sace āsane vā nisīdati āmisaṃ vā paṭiggaṇhāti dhammaṃ vā bhāsati ṭhānaṃ bhañjati.
